title: euodia waialealae
intro: Euodia waialealae, commonly known as the Kukui nut tree, is a plant species native to Hawaii. It is a deciduous tree with fragrant flowers and small, oval-shaped leaves. The health benefits of Euodia waialealae include its potential anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include limonoids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects.
